flow.question: How does the mediation process work?
flow.answer: Each party enters private positions, the AI suggests a middle-ground proposal, and both parties accept or reject it over successive rounds.

privacy.question: How are my private positions protected?
privacy.answer: Only you can see your positions. The other party never accesses that information — they only see the already-sanitized proposals.

afterAgreement.question: What happens after reaching an agreement?
afterAgreement.answer: The agreement becomes available for both parties to review and sign before it's marked complete.

signatureSimulation.question: Are the signatures legally valid?
signatureSimulation.answer: Not yet. In this demo, signing is a simulated in-app confirmation, with no legal validity or cryptographic certification.

mediator.question: When does a mediator get involved?
mediator.answer: If a negotiation doesn't reach an agreement after two rounds, requesting a mediator becomes available from the third round.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.body: General information about using the app during this demonstration stage. This content does not constitute legal advice. The final version must be reviewed by the legal team.

privacyNotice.title: Privacy notice
privacyNotice.body: A general description of how information is handled within this demonstration environment. This content does not constitute legal advice. The final version must be reviewed by the legal team.

aiNotice.title: AI assistance notice
aiNotice.body: Artificial intelligence suggests agreement proposals, but never decides or replaces the judgment of the parties or a mediator. This content does not constitute legal advice.

signatureNotice.title: Signature simulation notice
signatureNotice.body: Signatures recorded in this demo are simulated: they have no legal validity and do not use a certified signature provider. This content does not constitute legal advice.

noAdvice.title: No legal advice
noAdvice.body: Nothing shown in this app constitutes legal advice. The final version must be reviewed by the legal team before publication.

retention.title: Retention and account deactivation
retention.body: When an account is deactivated, your personal data is anonymized (not deleted) after 6 months. Your cases and agreements are kept so the other party can keep accessing them, and you'll show up as "Deactivated user". The other party is notified when this happens. This content does not constitute legal advice.
